verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own core Bases plugin creates database-like views of notes (docs-6), and Notion databases are converted into Bases on import (docs-29). A community user describes Bases as a faster, near-complete replacement for Dataview-style querying (comm-5). This points to first-party metadata-driven organization and retrieval, but the pack never explicitly documents typed properties or tags. missing for 10: explicit documentation of typed note properties (frontmatter/property types), tag support and tag search, consistent property management across the vault, independent hands-on corroboration of property/tag workflows.
